title: Lost Fishing Gear Keeps Killing 100,000 Animals A Year
hook: Lost fishing gear kills 100,000 animals without anyone holding it.
closing: Discarded gear keeps hunting long after crews leave the water.
question: Who should retrieve lost fishing gear?

segments.say: Fishing gear makes up 10% of ocean litter, becoming traps nobody monitors.
Lost fishing gear weighs 640,000 metric tons yearly, about 63 Eiffel Towers.
Ghost fishing gear traps 100,000 marine animals yearly, continuing to kill without fishers.
